title: Hybrid Generative-Tagging Decoding for Efficient Product Attribute-Value Extraction
abstract: arXiv:2610.21329v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Attribute-value extraction is important for building high-quality product catalogs in e-commerce. Existing systems either rely on generative or tagging strategies for extracting the attribute names and their corresponding values. Tagging models directly label spans in the source, making them fast and grounded, but they cannot produce values that require reformatting or generate rare attribute names outside their label space. Generative models avoid these drawbacks by generating both attribute names and values token by token, but this auto-regressive nature makes them slow and limits attribute coverage. We introduce hybrid generative-tagging decoding, a novel model architecture that combines tagging source spans and open-ended generation. For frequent attributes whose values are copyable, a tagging head extracts values directly from the source. This lets the generative head focus on the remainder - rare attributes outside the tagger's lab

translated_title: 面向高效产品属性-值抽取的混合生成-标注解码方法
translated_abstract: 属性-值抽取对于构建高质量的电子商务产品目录至关重要。现有系统在抽取属性名称及其对应值时，要么依赖生成式策略，要么依赖标注式策略。标注模型直接对源文本中的片段进行标记，因此速度快且忠实于原文，但它们无法生成需要重新格式化的值，也无法生成其标签空间之外的稀有属性名称。生成式模型通过逐个token地生成属性名称和值，避免了这些缺点，但这种自回归特性使其速度缓慢，并限制了属性覆盖范围。我们提出了混合生成-标注解码，这是一种将源文本片段标注与开放式生成相结合的新型模型架构。对于值可直接复制的常见属性，标注头直接从源文本中抽取值，这使得生成头能够专注于其余部分——即标注器标签空间之外的稀有属性。
tldr: 提出混合生成-标注解码架构，对可复制的常见属性由标注头直接从源文本抽取值，使生成头专注于稀有属性，从而实现更快速且属性覆盖更广的产品属性-值抽取。
en_tdlr: A hybrid generative-tagging decoding architecture is proposed, where a tagging head directly extracts copyable values of frequent attributes from the source while the generative head focuses on rare attributes, achieving faster and broader-coverage product attribute-value extraction.
